summary: • An emotional, first-person illustrated storybook told from the perspective of NASA's Surveyor 3 lander, exploring its historic 1967 lunar mission, its lonely years in the dark, and its unforgettable reunion with Apollo 12 astronauts.
details:
Project Overview:

"I Am Surveyor 3: Echoes in the Lunar Dust" is an illustrated digital storybook created for the "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" challenge. Written from the first-person perspective of NASA's Surveyor 3 robotic lander, the story combines real historical and scientific mission data with an emotional narrative to show how abandoned spacecraft on the Moon remain vital monuments of human exploration.

How It Was Created & NASA Data Used:

Using official archival data and imagery from NASA Science, the NASA Image and Video Library, The Planetary Society, and Wikipedia, the story accurately follows Surveyor 3's journey: its bumpy double-bounce landing on April 20, 1967, its soil-digging tests and 6,326 photographs, the freezing -150°C lunar night, and the historic November 1969 visit by Apollo 12 astronauts Pete Conrad and Alan Bean.

AI Transparency Disclosure:

The original narrative concept, story writing, and presentation design were created entirely by the author. Artificial Intelligence tools were used solely to assist in summarizing historical research, translating the original Turkish text into English, and structuring the presentation.
